patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Magento documents a broader use-case set; Tiendanube is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — Magento documents a broader use-case set; Tiendanube is narrower/specialist.. Choose Magento only if your buying job matches “Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quote) — deep” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Magento's shape. Workflow advantage: Magento leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b; Tiendanube leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Magento documents a broader use-case set; Tiendanube is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Magento is Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quote) — deep catalog/B2B with high hosting and agency TCO.; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Company-size focus: Magento (mid-market, enterprise) vs Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Magento-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b, order-fulfillment vs Tiendanube-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Magento — Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Magento: Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0; Adobe Commerce pricing is opaque (GMV quote) — hard to compare without a partner worksheet; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Magento is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0 · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Magento if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
